basics.name: Daattavya Aggarwal
basics.label: At the intersection of mathematics, computer science and physics
basics.summary: Interested in AI-guided mathematical discovery and it's applications to mathematical physics, geometry and number theory

work.name: University of Cambridge
work.position: PhD student in AI for Mathematical Discovery
work.summary: Developing novel methods for guided mathematical discovery by AI systems. Attempting to apply these approaches to reasearch problems. Have previously worked on problems in geometry and number theory.

awards.title: Felix Scholar
awards.summary: A full ride scholarship for five Indian students yearly to study at the University of Oxford. Generously supported by an anonymous donor.

publications.name: Discovering Mathematical Concepts through a Multi-Agent System
publications.summary: A multi-agent model for computational mathematical discovery that poses its own conjectures and attempts to prove them, benchmarked on recovering the concept of homology from polyhedral data.

publications.name: A Remark on Weighted Average Multiplicities in Prime Factorisation
publications.summary: A study of weighted average multiplicity (WAM), a generalisation of the quality of an ABC triple, connecting it to the standard ABC conjecture.

publications.name: Machine Learning Sasakian and G2 Topology on Contact Calabi-Yau 7-Manifolds
publications.summary: A machine learning approach to study topological quantities related to Sasakian and G2-geometries of contact Calabi-Yau 7-manifolds.

publications.name: Generalized Boolean Functions and Quantum Circuits on IBM-Q
publications.summary: Deriving a connection between quantum circuits using IBM's quantum gate set and multivariate quadratic polynomials over integers modulo 8.

publications.name: Application of Quantum Scrambling in Rydberg Atom on IBM Quantum Computer
publications.summary: A general quantum circuit to implement an interferometric protocol for measuring out-of-time-ordered correlator (OTOC) functions in Rydberg atom simulations.
